item.title: Thousands of Farmers Rally in Athlone Against Mercosur Trade Deal
item.description: Thousands of farmers from across the country have descended on Athlone today to protest against the Mercosur Trade Deal. It comes as EU member states voted in favour of the deal yesterday with Ireland voting No. Advertisement The deal will open the EU market to almost a hundred thousand tonnes of South American beef a year. item.title: Gardaí warning motorists of icy conditions along Carrick-on-Shannon roads
item.description: Gardaí in Carrick-on-Shannon are warning motorists to exercise caution on the roads today. They're appealing to the public to be wary of icy conditions on roads in the area, particularly on the SuperValu car park, Shannon lodge and the Coolabawn area in Mohill towards the Modular Factory. An Garda Síochána has received reports of accidents in the area and are reminding people to dry safely throughout the weekend. Advertisement

item.title: Funeral of man who died after alleged Ballagh assault to take place in England, as fundraiser raises almost €10,000
item.description: The body of a 39-year-old man who died after an alleged assault in Ballaghaderreen is to be repatriated to England for his funeral. A fundraising appeal has raised almost €10,000. Father-of-three Jordon Newin, from England, died after an alleged assault in Ballaghaderreen in the early hours of New Year’s Day. item.title: Fitzmaurice Pledges Ongoing Resistance to Mercosur Trade Deal
item.description: Independent Ireland TD Michael Fitzmaurice says efforts will continue to oppose the Mercosur Trade Deal despite the EU voting to back it. He was speaking in Athlone today as thousands of farmers staged a protest against the deal. Yesterday's vote will see almost a hundred thousand tonnes of South American beef gain access to the EU market. item.title: "Government sent clear message by rural Ireland" - local TD speaks at anti-Mercosur protest
item.description: The Government was sent a clear message by rural Ireland during today's protest against the Mercosur deal in Athlone. That's the view of Sligo-Leitrim Sinn Féin TD Martin Kenny, who says farmers were left feeling betrayed over negotiations around the trade deal. Thousands of tractors and protestors on foot protested in the midlands town before gathering at the TÚS campus this afternoon. item.title: Longford bow out of O'Byrne shield
item.description: Longford bowed out of the O’Byrne shield after a 10-point defeat to Wicklow in Bray Emmets. Eoin Darcy, Sean Murphy and Darragh Fee found the back of the net for the hosts as Wicklow won out 3-15 to 1-11. The garden county had led 2-6 to 0-5 at half-time. Cathal McCabe’s 38th minute goal made a three point game, however it wasn’t to be as Wicklow won out by 10-points. item.title: Galway comeback to down Leitirm
item.description: Matthew Thompson found the net twice as Galway scored a big win over Leitirm in the FBD league. Galway came from behind to beat Leitrim, 2-19 to 0-14 at Tuam Stadium and advance to the FBD League final. Thompson’s opening minute goal gave the Connacht champions the perfect start ahead. Advertisement However, Leitrim responded well and led at half-time 10-points to 1-4.
